description: Immutable data object representing savings account charge data in the Fineract project.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeData
classes.description: Immutable data object for Savings Account charge data, including charge details, status, fees, and options.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a default or empty instance of SavingsAccountChargeData with charge options.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a fully populated instance of SavingsAccountChargeData with provided parameters.

methods.name: isFeeCharge
methods.description: Checks if the charge is a fee (not penalty).

methods.name: calculateAmountOrPercentage
methods.description: Determines whether to use amount or percentage based on charge calculation type.

methods.name: isWithdrawalFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is a withdrawal fee based on charge time type.

methods.name: isAnnualFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is an annual fee based on charge time type.

methods.name: isSavingsActivation
methods.description: Checks if the charge is related to savings activation based on charge time type.
